newsitem.title: USA: Mitchell Energy completes property sales.
newsitem.headline: Mitchell Energy completes property sales.

text.p: Mitchell Energy & Development Corp said Monday it has sold a portfolio of real estate for $38 million in pre-tax proceeds, including a $9 million note receivable.

The properties include a shopping center and several retail buildings near The Woodlands Mall in Texas, to a partnership that is 25 percent owned by Mitchell and 75 percent owned by Crescent Real Estate Equities Inc.
The company said it is seeking to close other real estate sales in the fourth quarter worth $50 million in pre-tax cash proceeds.

The latest sales combined with those that are pending and earlier sales should bring $100 million in cash this year, the company said, adding that the money would be used to pay down debt and grow operations in The Woodlands.
Mitchell Energy is developing 200,000 acres 27 miles north of Houston through its subsidiary, The Woodlands Corp.
